# Three.js

three.min.js is the unmodified Three.js 0.132.2 build from the official r132 release:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r132/build/three.min.js

The game and tests use this same build. It is vendored so opening the game through
a local server and running tests do not require a CDN or a package installation.
The upstream MIT license is included in LICENSE.three.
